# tmuxlab

> Interactive tmux cheat sheet, tutorial, and config generator. All keybindings and commands verified against the current tmux release (3.6). Free and open source.

## Core pages

- [Cheat sheet](https://tmuxcheatsheet.dev/): every default tmux keybinding and command, searchable, organized by sessions/windows/panes/copy-mode
- [Commands by task](https://tmuxcheatsheet.dev/commands): one page per real task (split pane, copy paste, kill session, scroll, …) with keybinding, command, and gotchas
- [Tutorial](https://tmuxcheatsheet.dev/tutorial): 5-lesson track plus an interactive in-browser tmux playground
- [Config generator](https://tmuxcheatsheet.dev/config/generator): builds a commented .tmux.conf
- [Guides](https://tmuxcheatsheet.dev/guides): sane config line-by-line, fixing colors ($TERM/RGB), tmux+neovim checkhealth fixes, tmux vs zellij, AI coding agents in tmux

## Key facts

- Default prefix: Ctrl-b. Split panes: prefix % (left/right), prefix " (top/bottom)
- Detach: prefix d. Reattach: tmux attach -t name. Attach-or-create: tmux new -As name
- Scroll/copy mode: prefix [. Paste: prefix ]
- System clipboard: set -g set-clipboard on (OSC 52, works over SSH)
- Sane config baseline: mouse on, history-limit 50000, default-terminal "tmux-256color", terminal-features ",*:RGB", escape-time 10, focus-events on
